reasoning: Shows an upward-pointing airplane crossed out by a diagonal slash, universally read as 'cancelled flight', 'no flying', or 'airplane mode off'. It fits specific travel admin tasks around cancelling tickets, handling flight cancellations, or drone no-fly zones, though at tiny sizes the slash must be distinguished from a plain airplane icon.
